description: Drafts text, media, polls, locations, forwards; sends nothing. Call it as soon as you have recipient and text: it returns draft_id and preview (recipient, number, exact text). Show that preview; confirm_send only on a yes to this text and recipient — a send in the same request is that yes.

as.description: Media: send as a document, voice note or GIF

chat_id.description: Chat id, or a phone number

file_path.description: Media: a path on wazap's machine

mention_ids.description: Chat ids to @-mention; write @<number> in text for each

send_at.description: Send later: "2026-10-12T09:00" in time_zone, or with an offset

text.description: The message, or caption, poll question, place name; "" for a forward, voice note or audio

time_zone.description: IANA zone for send_at; the server's by default

name: send_message
title: Draft a WhatsApp message
